{\Large\bfseries Supplementary Material}\\[6pt]
{\large Log-Transformed Red-Tailed Hawk Optimization for\\
Single-Diode Photovoltaic Parameter Extraction}\\[4pt]
Salma El Aamery and Rachid El Bachtiri\\
Laboratory of Innovative Technologies and Computer Science,\\
Higher School of Technology, Sidi Mohamed Ben Abdellah University,\\
Fez, Morocco
\end{center}

This document reports the complete equal function-evaluation (FE) results used in the revised manuscript.  Each algorithm receives exactly $149050$ objective evaluations per run, with $N=50$ and 30 matched runs. For dataset $d$ and run $r$, all algorithms use \texttt{rng(50000 + 1000*d + r)}, so the initial population is identical within a matched run.  RTH uses 1000 iterations; the single-evaluation algorithms use 2980 iterations; HHO uses an FE-based progress and stopping rule because its evaluation count per iteration is branch-dependent.

The near-zero RTH dispersion is reported as numerical convergence under this protocol, not as proof of a certified global optimum.  The MATLAB files \texttt{Benchmark\_EqualFE.m}, \texttt{make\_counted\_objective.m}, \texttt{HHO\_FE.m}, and the saved MAT/CSV outputs accompany this document.
